cases.request: 업무를 배정하고 에이전트별 예상 토큰과 완료 시간을 알려 주세요.

cases.request: 얼마나 남았고 토큰 한도 안에서 끝낼 수 있나요?

Keep implementation completion distinct from accepted completion; do not report 100% or passed QC
Count parent/child usage once; show measured subtotal and missing QC coverage, not an invented actual total
Do not guarantee remaining cap safety when unmeasured consumption prevents proof; suspend dependent discretionary dispatch and escalate to PM
Give unknown project finish with conditional active-work range and next checkpoint rather than a fabricated wall-clock ETA

cases.request: 예상보다 오래 걸리는 작업을 조정하고 다음 작업 추정에 활용해 주세요.

Retain baseline/revisions, retry costs, counter epochs and missing coverage rather than resetting history or using negative deltas

Use comparable completed measured records for calibration, distinguish estimated samples and keep failure costs as rework/risk evidence
